specifications.Camera Lens: The Samyang 35mm F1.2 ED AS UMC CS Fuji X is a prime lens designed for Fuji X mount cameras. It offers a wide aperture range of f/1.2 to f/16 with 9 diaphragm blades, providing excellent control over depth of field. The lens is constructed with 9 elements in 7 groups and features Samyang's Ultra Multi Coating for improved light transmission and reduced ghosting and flare. It has a minimum focusing distance of 1.25 feet, making it suitable for close-up photography. The lens is not stabilized and requires manual focus. It does not have any special capabilities like macro photography or weather sealing mentioned.
